title: 逼真的产品照片
prompt: A realistic product photo of a [brand name] [bottle or jar] sculpted entirely from fresh [ingredient name], arranged perfectly to form the shape of the original packaging, including a detailed and accurate label on the front. The background is a clean, soft light gray with a natural wooden surface. Studio lighting, soft shadows, 1:1 square composition, professional product photography style, ultra-detailed textures, vibrant and glossy finish
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松生成逼真产品照片，完美适用于化妆品和食品行业的品牌宣传，突出自然材质与光泽质感。通过专业摄影风格和超细腻纹理，展现产品在工作室灯光下的生动细节，提升视觉吸引力。
